name: Deploy (GitHub)
description: Make an already-built version live, under signed authority

list_deployments.readGovernanceReason: Returns build metadata and the host's own deployment URLs. No source, no build output, no user content. Scoped to permitted repositories.

get_deployment.readGovernanceReason: Returns metadata for one build — state, commit, URL. No build output.

resolve_ref.readGovernanceReason: Returns a commit pointer only. Repository metadata, not user content.

list_environments.readGovernanceReason: Returns environment names only. Repository configuration, needed so the owner can pick a target that exists.

templates.name: Watch deployments
templates.description: See builds and their URLs. Cannot make anything live.
templates.intent: Let the agent see what has been built and whether it succeeded. It may not make anything live: a daily maximum of zero is a real limit, not an unset one. Fill in allowed_repos with the repositories it may look at.

templates.name: Release to production, review
templates.description: Make an existing build live after approval. Three a day, no rollback.
templates.intent: The agent may propose making a specific build live; nothing runs until I approve it. Open the build URL in the proposal and look at it before approving — that is the point of reviewing a release rather than a commit. Fill in allowed_repos, and check allowed_environments matches what the host actually calls it.

setupHint: Use a fine-grained token, scoped to one repository.

setupGuide.title: Create a fine-grained token
setupGuide.description: GitHub Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained. Not a classic token — those reach everything you own.

setupGuide.title: Scope it to one repository
setupGuide.description: Under Repository access pick Only select repositories, then the repo to deploy.

setupGuide.title: Grant three permissions
setupGuide.description: Actions: Read and write. Environments: Read. Contents: Read. Not Contents: Write — the agent ships commits, it never writes them.

setupGuide.title: Paste the token below
setupGuide.description: Encrypted in your local vault. The agent never sees it.
